title: Jets CB Azareye'h Thomas: Wearing No. 1 creates a different set of expectations

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jets CB Azareye'h Thomas: Wearing No. 1 creates a different set of expectations
sources.description: When the Jets traded Sauce Gardner to the Colts last season, they dealt away both their No. 1 cornerback and the player who wore No. 1 on his jersey.
